::: {#def-pooled-t-test}
#### Pooled two-sample t-test

With the notation of @def-two-sample-t-test
and the [pooled variance](#def-pooled-variance) $s_p^2$,
the **pooled two-sample t-test** of $H_0: \mu_1 = \mu_2$
uses the statistic

$$t_p \eqdef \frac{\bar{x}_1 - \bar{x}_2}{s_p \sqrt{\dfrac{1}{n_1} + \dfrac{1}{n_2}}}.$$

Its p-value is $\Pr(\abs{T} \ge \abs{t_p})$,
where $T$ has the $t_{n_1 + n_2 - 2}$ distribution.
:::
